why: Reduce each reading to its repeated digit sum (a short simulation), then this is a frequency count over the 10 possible digits, with ties going to the larger digit.
hints: After reduction every value is 0..9, so a count array of size 10 is enough.
Reduce with a loop: while x >= 10, replace x by the sum of its digits. (Shortcut: for x > 0 the result is 1 + (x-1) % 9.)
Count the digits, then scan 0..9 and keep the digit whose count is >= the best so far, so ties go to the larger digit. O(n * digits).
pitfalls: Ties go to the highest digit, not the first one seen.
0 stays 0. The 1 + (x-1) % 9 shortcut is wrong for x = 0.
